name: Gauntlet USDC Prime
oneLiner: gtUSDCp is the Gauntlet-curated MetaMorpho V2 vault for USDC, an ERC-4626 wrapper compounding USDC lending yield across permissioned Morpho markets.

sources.label: Gauntlet USDC Prime Ethereum vault contract

blacklistabilityReview.sourceFreeRationale: Bounded unknown retained: the reviewed vault and Morpho materials establish USDC exposure and curator controls, but do not establish a complete holder-level blacklist or freeze inventory for the vault share token and all tracked routes.
blacklistabilityReview.evidence: gtUSDCp is a Morpho vault exposure to USDC and inherits Circle's upstream blacklist surface. The reviewed vault and curator sources do not prove a direct holder-control function for gtUSDCp itself or a deployment-wide control inventory.
blacklistabilityReview.reviewer: SONG Safety Score V9 access review

mintAuthority.summary: gtUSDCp has three direct immutable Morpho vault deployments; shares mint only against each chain's USDC deposits. Ethereum and Base parameter owners are 4-of-7 Gauntlet Safes, while Arbitrum uses the same seven signers at a 3-of-7 threshold.

controls.label: Gauntlet USDC Prime MetaMorpho V2 vault Ethereum (immutable, deposit-only mint)
controls.capDescription: Vault shares minted only against deposited USDC. No EIP-1967 proxy slots — vault is immutable. Owner (0xc684c6587712e5e7bdf9fd64415f23bd2b05faec) is the Gauntlet Safe 4/7 managing parameters only.
controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 25527215, the verified VaultV2 deployment had zero EIP-1967 implementation, admin, and beacon slots. asset() returned Ethereum USDC and owner() returned Safe 0xc684c6587712e5e7bdf9fd64415f23bd2b05faec, configured 4-of-7 with no modules or guard. The owner manages vault parameters but cannot replace the deployed bytecode.

controls.label: Gauntlet USDC Prime MetaMorpho vault Base (immutable, deposit-only mint)
controls.capDescription: Vault shares mint only against deposited Base USDC. Owner 0x5a4e19842e09000a582c20a4f524c26fb48dd4d0 is a 4-of-7 Gauntlet Safe that manages parameters but cannot replace the immutable vault bytecode.
controls.evidence: At Base block 48599296, the verified MetaMorpho deployment had zero EIP-1967 implementation, admin, and beacon slots. asset() returned native Base USDC and owner() returned Safe 0x5a4e19842e09000a582c20a4f524c26fb48dd4d0, configured 4-of-7 with no modules or guard.

controls.label: Gauntlet USDC Prime MetaMorpho vault Arbitrum (immutable, deposit-only mint)
controls.capDescription: Vault shares mint only against deposited Arbitrum USDC. Owner 0x5a4e19842e09000a582c20a4f524c26fb48dd4d0 is a 3-of-7 Gauntlet Safe that manages parameters but cannot replace the immutable vault bytecode.
controls.evidence: At Arbitrum block 483587934, the verified MetaMorphoV1_1 deployment had zero EIP-1967 implementation, admin, and beacon slots. asset() returned native Arbitrum USDC and owner() returned Safe 0x5a4e19842e09000a582c20a4f524c26fb48dd4d0, configured 3-of-7 with no modules or guard.

review.evidence: The full three-chain inventory was checked independently: Ethereum at block 25527215, Base at block 48599296, and Arbitrum at block 483587934. Every verified direct vault had zero EIP-1967 implementation, admin, and beacon slots and returned the chain-local native USDC as asset(). Ethereum owner 0xc684c6587712e5e7bdf9fd64415f23bd2b05faec and Base owner 0x5a4e19842e09000a582c20a4f524c26fb48dd4d0 were 4-of-7 Safes; the same Arbitrum owner address was 3-of-7. All three had no modules or guard. Owners can curate vault parameters but cannot replace vault bytecode or mint base USDC.
review.reviewer: Codex Safety Score V9 registry pass

collateral: USDC deposited into a Gauntlet-curated MetaMorpho V2 vault on Morpho Blue; the curator allocates across permissioned USDC lending markets backed by blue-chip crypto and real-world asset collateral
pegMechanism: ERC-4626 MetaMorpho V2 vault shares appreciate against USDC as borrower interest accrues; withdrawals redeem vault shares for available USDC liquidity or wait for Morpho market liquidity to return

slice.name: USDC deposited into Gauntlet-curated Morpho lending markets

bridgeRouteRisk.summary: gtUSDCp has reviewed cross-chain route evidence through Across, an intent/liquidity framework rather than issuer-native settlement. The route is scored as liquidity/intent because execution and available bridge liquidity are material to cross-chain movement.
